title: Lorenz-63 RK4 floating-point evaluation order clarification
reason: Lorenz-63 is chaotic. Algebraically equivalent floating-point arrangements of the RK4 state update can diverge materially after the frozen 5000-step burn-in. The exact source-level evaluation order must therefore be frozen before any V2 development outcome is generated.
numerical_type: numpy float64 arrays and scalar float64-compatible arithmetic

rk4_step.implementation_rule: Use the expression above in this parenthesization/order. Do not rewrite the final update as dt*(...)/6.0 or use an adaptive/vectorized ODE solver.

sampling.first_returned_sample: x immediately after the 5000th exact RK4 step

reproducibility_scope: Source-level operation order is frozen for the pinned V2 Python/NumPy environment. No claim of bit-for-bit identity across arbitrary hardware, compilers, or future NumPy versions.
scientific_effect: Implementation clarification only. No development or final performance outcome was generated or inspected to choose this rule.
